intro.text: Our reading picnic is nearly ready. But the big moon lantern is missing! Let’s follow the clues. No need to hurry.
intro.speaker: harpreet

kabirHello.text: I saw something blue flutter past the gate. Was it a tiny dragon? We should check the clues before we guess!
kabirHello.speaker: kabir

meenaHello.text: I moved a lantern out of the breeze so it would stay safe. Then I forgot to leave a note! The plant labels will show you where.
meenaHello.speaker: meena

cantCombine.text: That is a useful clue. Keep it in your pocket and look around. Use the notebook to see how the clues fit together.
cantCombine.speaker: harpreet

saveResume.text: Welcome back, detective. Your clues are safe. Open the notebook if you want to remember what we found.
saveResume.speaker: harpreet

gateBlocked.text: We need three clues: the ribbon colour, the kind of flower, and the plant number. The notebook will help.
gateBlocked.speaker: harpreet

needSnacks.text: We found the lantern! Let’s collect twelve snacks from the reading room before we start the picnic.
needSnacks.speaker: harpreet

needLantern.text: First, take a look at the moon lantern. How did it get here?
needLantern.speaker: harpreet

lanternFound.text: There it is, safe beside the moonflowers! A blue ribbon, a moonflower petal, and plant number 13. All our clues fit.
lanternFound.speaker: harpreet

meenaSorry.text: The breeze tugged at its ribbon. I brought it here to keep it safe. I’m sorry I forgot the note.
meenaSorry.speaker: meena

kabirEnd.text: So nobody took it! And the greenhouse is a lovely place for a reading picnic. Can I sit by the moonflowers?
kabirEnd.speaker: kabir

picnicEnd.text: Twelve snacks for all of us, one rescued lantern, and a story to share. Good detectives count carefully and ask kindly.
picnicEnd.speaker: harpreet

alreadyShared.text: Our picnic is ready. Everyone has a place beside the lantern.
alreadyShared.speaker: harpreet

deduction.text: The blue ribbon, moonflower petal and number 13 all match. Where should we look?
deduction.speaker: harpreet

deductionRetry.text: Let’s use all three clues together: blue ribbon, moonflowers, and plant 13. Where can we find all three?
deductionRetry.speaker: harpreet

gateOpen.text: The gate opens onto a warm little greenhouse. Let’s see if our idea was right.
gateOpen.speaker: harpreet

flowersDone.text: Six plus six is twelve. Meena smiles: “Just right for our picnic!”
flowersDone.speaker: harpreet

hooks.text: Ten hooks, six little lanterns. How many hooks are empty?
hooks.speaker: harpreet

hooksHelp.text: Let’s look together. Count each empty hook once. Or start at six and count on to ten: seven, eight, nine, ten.
hooksHelp.speaker: harpreet

hooksDone.text: Six lanterns and four empty hooks make ten. A blue ribbon is caught on the last hook. A clue!
hooksDone.speaker: harpreet

snacks.text: There are seven apple slices and five crackers. How many snacks altogether?
snacks.speaker: harpreet

snacksHelp.text: Let’s look together. Touch each snack to count it. Start at seven and count five more: eight, nine, ten, eleven, twelve.
snacksHelp.speaker: harpreet

snacksDone.text: Seven plus five is twelve. The picnic snacks are packed. Let’s take them along!
snacksDone.speaker: harpreet

trails.text: The long trail has fourteen prints. The short trail has twelve. Which trail has more?
trails.speaker: harpreet

trailsHelp.text: Let’s look together. Compare the matching pairs of prints. The trail with fourteen has two left over.
trailsHelp.speaker: harpreet

trailsDone.text: Fourteen is more than twelve. The longer trail leads to the moonflowers. Here is a fallen moonflower petal!
trailsDone.speaker: harpreet

ribbons.text: Blue, gold, blue, gold, blue… Which ribbon colour comes next?
ribbons.speaker: harpreet

ribbonsHelp.text: Let’s look together. Say the repeating part: blue, gold. After blue comes gold.
ribbonsHelp.speaker: harpreet

ribbonsDone.text: Gold comes next. This ribbon line repeats blue, gold. Our loose blue ribbon matches the greenhouse decorations!
ribbonsDone.speaker: harpreet

labels.text: The plant labels read eleven, twelve, a missing number, fourteen. Which number is missing?
labels.speaker: harpreet

labelsHelp.text: Let’s look together. Count forward one at a time: eleven, twelve, thirteen, fourteen.
labelsHelp.speaker: harpreet

labelsDone.text: Thirteen! This tag belongs beside the moonflowers in the greenhouse. Keep it as our last clue.
labelsDone.speaker: harpreet

flowers.text: Six flowers in this basket and six in that one. How many flowers altogether?
flowers.speaker: harpreet

flowersHelp.text: Let’s look together. Count six flowers, then six more. Or make ten first: six and four make ten, then add two.
flowersHelp.speaker: harpreet
